text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens, in good health and generally under the age of 40. 2. Possess a degree equivalent to a bachelor's degree from a Chinese university (for current graduates who have not yet received their degree certificates, they need to provide a pre-graduation certificate issued by their school or college to prove that they are capable of graduating successfully and obtaining the degree certificate by July 2025); 3. IELTS score of 6.0 or above, TOEFL score of 85 or above (or TOEFL Essentials score of 9 or above, the TOEFL score receiving code for Nanjing University is C288), Duolingo English Test score of 100 or above (https://englishtest.duolingo.cn/applicants). Graduation requirements: Pass HSK Level 3 (with a score of 180 or above).
